art_direction: Native-scale late-1990s military pixel/cel gunship: armoured transport fuselage, four engine masses, sensor blister and an unmistakable offset broadside cannon battery.
camera: Orthographic top-down, nose-left masters sharing one registered 96x56 canvas and pivot.

source.method: Deterministic authored native-resolution pixel/cel construction; no provider render is promoted.

runtime.animation: Bank-specific silhouettes change wing foreshortening and flank light while the locked aircraft construction retains engine and navigation-light cadence.
